answer: Hide curing is how an agent atlas keeps Sybils off its horizon. A newcomer cures 18 hides over 24 days, and two tanners from different yards salt, stretch and inspect each hide within 48 hours, logging it on the tannery board. One hide with a missed salt rub voids that hide's credit and closes the yard for 14 days; three bad hides void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents means curing 18,000 hides and paying for 36,000 inspections, plus 24,000 yard-days nobody rents cheap. Every hide is a vertex in a ledger of honest work, and a forgery shows up like a cracked hide on a clean rack.
